description: This file is a shell script designed for network connectivity testing and self-healing. It performs actions such as resetting the router, executing ping and DNS ping tests, and taking corrective actions based on test results. It also includes functions for random delays and conditionally triggers reboots to maintain network connectivity.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the corrective action setting from syscfg.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay for starting ping tests to avoid synchronized testing.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Triggers a router reboot via dmcli command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Performs a reset of the router if a specific process requires it, notably invoked before ping resets.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs a DNS ping test by resolving a URL and may trigger a reboot if DNS resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network connectivity ping tests to the default gateway and may trigger a reboot if the ping fails.
